{{Italic title}}
{{For|the free content released alongside this [[Dungeons:Downloadable content|DLC]]|MCD:1.3.2.0}}[[File:MinecraftDungeonsJungleAwakens.png|thumb|The cover of ''Jungle Awakens'']]
'''''Jungle Awakens''''' is the first paid {{MCD|DLC}} for {{MCD}}. It was released on July 1, 2020. It is the first DLC of the {{MCD|Hero Pass}}, the first DLC not set in the {{MCD|mainland}}, and the first DLC set in the {{MCD|island realms}}. It includes two {{MCD|mission}}s, {{MCD|Dingy Jungle}} and {{MCD|Overgrown Temple}}, a {{MCD|secret mission}}, {{MCD|Panda Plateau}}, and a {{MCD|boss}}, the {{MCD|Jungle Abomination}}, found in Overgrown Temple.

== Appearance ==
[[File:JungleAwakensIsland.png|thumb|The island  where ''Jungle Awakens'' takes place.]]
Jungle Awakens is set on an unnamed tropical island. The island contains jungle trees and vibrant flora in high abundance. On the west side of the island, there is the {{MCD|Dingy Jungle}}; a small lake, a cave entrance, and an offering platform. To the east is the {{MCD|Panda Plateau}}, a bamboo forest where a large panda head seems to be built into the terrain.  At the top of the island is the {{MCD|Overgrown Temple}}, an ancient, run-down temple upon a hill with decorative waterfalls flowing out the sides. A small beach and several smaller islands appear on the island map, though most of the details listed do not appear in-game.

== Quotes ==
{{Q|Only you can fight back against the snarling overgrowth to free this distant jungle from a mysterious power. The path is perilous – new [[#Entities|foes]] and dangerous puzzles wait in the shade. Find new [[#Armor|armour]], [[#Weapons|weapons]], and [[#Artifacts|artifacts]] as you seek to uproot the source of the wicked corruption: the {{MCD|Jungle Abomination}}.|In-game pre-purchase description}}
== Trivia ==
* This DLC was accidentally released early on June 30 for players on {{Wikipedia|Xbox One}} and {{Wikipedia|Windows 10}} through the {{Wikipedia|Microsoft Store}}.
* This is the only DLC that doesn't have a {{MCD||Minecraft Dungeons Diaries}} episode on it.
* It was originally believed that the shard of the orb of dominance created the leapleaf and the whisperer. It was found out after rereading the original "Jungle DLC Out Today Page," that the shard corrupted the two species rather than creating them.<ref>[https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/jungle-awakens-dlc-out-today]|”One of its shards has found its way to a lush jungle, corrupting both the land and its inhabitants.”</ref>
